user_story: As a user, I want to see a notification message when I click the link so that I can be informed of actions taken. Acceptance criteria: 1. When I navigate to 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/notification_message_rendered', I should see the heading 'Notification Message'. 2. When I click the link 'Click here', I should be redirected to the same page and see the notification message visible in the element with id 'flash-messages'.
